dataset.title: Core Anatomy Structures + Muscles
dataset.description: Unified anatomy concept database for bones, joints, ligaments, vessels, nerves, organs, CNS structures and skeletal muscles. Muscle concepts are migrated from the legacy muscle table and linked conservatively to existing nerves, arteries, bones and ligaments.

language_policy.note: English and Latin remain canonical base terms. Slovak and German preferred terms are populated in v2.2; each vernacular term carries source_backed or seed_needs_review provenance so review status is never implied by mere presence.

dataset.review_warning: Educational seed with explicit field-level terminology provenance. Preferred SK/DE coverage is complete, but seed_needs_review entries are not faculty-verified and must remain distinguishable from source-backed terminology.

muscle_integration.translation_policy: Do not use translated region/category labels as muscle-name translations.

terminology_layer.policy: Unverified vernacular seeds remain explicitly marked seed_needs_review; no category label may masquerade as a structure translation.

adjacent_to.description: Source lies immediately next to target or has a clinically meaningful direct anatomical adjacency.

bifurcates_into.description: Source divides at a defined bifurcation into target as one of its daughter structures.

branch_of.description: Source is an anatomical branch arising from target.

conducts_air_to.description: Source airway conducts inspired/expired air toward target.

contains_pathway_component.description: Source anatomical pathway contains target as an explicitly represented component of that pathway.

continues_as.description: Source continues anatomically as target without being represented as a branching event.

drains_to.description: Source drains venous, lymphatic or other fluid content into target.

formed_by.description: Source is formed by union or convergence involving target.

forms_part_of_joint.description: Source contributes structurally to target joint.

gives_branch_to.description: Source gives rise to target as a direct anatomical branch.

has_part.description: Target is a structural component of source.

inferior_to.description: Source lies anatomically inferior to target.

inserts_on.description: Source muscle or tendon inserts on target structure.

joins_to_form.description: Source joins another represented structure or paired structure to form target.

located_in.description: Source is spatially contained within target region, bone, canal, fossa or other anatomical container.

originates_from.description: Source muscle, vessel or other structure originates from target.

part_of.description: Source is a structural component of target.

passes_anterior_to.description: Source passes directly anterior to target along its anatomical course.

passes_through.description: Source traverses target opening, canal, fissure or compartment.

posterior_to.description: Source lies anatomically posterior to target.

receives_blood_from.description: Source organ or structure receives blood from target vessel.

supplied_by.description: Source receives arterial blood supply from target.

supplies.description: Source vessel supplies target with arterial blood.

articulates_with.description: Source and target form a direct synovial, cartilaginous or fibrous articulation with each other.

contains.description: Source anatomical compartment, organ or space contains target as a represented component or traversing structure.

surrounds.description: Source surrounds or envelops target over a clinically meaningful anatomical extent.

surrounded_by.description: Source is surrounded or enveloped by target over a clinically meaningful anatomical extent.

opens_into.description: Source duct, tube, cavity or organ has an anatomical opening into target.

communicates_with.description: Source and target spaces or lumina communicate through a defined anatomical passage.

forms_boundary_of.description: Source forms a named anatomical boundary of target space, compartment or region.

bounded_by.description: Source space, compartment or region has target as a named anatomical boundary.

anastomoses_with.description: Source vessel forms an anatomical vascular connection or anastomosis with target.

carries_blood_to.description: Source vessel carries blood toward target organ or vascular territory without implying nutritive arterial supply.

receives_input_from.description: Source neural structure or pathway receives represented sensory or neural input from target.

projects_to.description: Source neural pathway or tract projects to target represented neural structure.

covers.description: Source membrane or layer covers or invests a represented surface of target.

extends_through.description: Source system or elongated structure extends through or has major represented components within target.

attaches_to.description: Source ligament, fascia, membrane, tendon or other structure has a named anatomical attachment to target.
